name: gemus
description: Build node-based AI design workflows on the Gemus canvas from your own Codex. Describe a workflow in plain language and Gemus creates the nodes, generates images/video/3D/PPT, and opens the result at gemus.ai.

interface.shortDescription: AI design workflows on the Gemus canvas
interface.longDescription: Gemus is a visual AI design workflow platform. This plugin adds a default-disabled Companion MCP server plus a Stop hook and skills so your local Codex can build workflows, run AI generation, and automatically backfill Codex's own image generations onto planned canvas nodes. On Windows or macOS, run the safe-to-rerun one-command setup, restart Codex, then open a new task. Self-hosted and Linux users can use the documented manual fallback. View results at gemus.ai.
defaultPrompt: Use Gemus to build a workflow for a coffee brand identity.
Ask Gemus to generate a hero image and open the canvas.
